snippet.title: NORDIC ASHES: Remnants of Corruption - DLC Trailer #survivor #roguelike
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2068280
Gog: coming soon
Epic: coming soon

Remnants of Corruption will take place inside the Skada Tower, a dark corrupt place. Once you step inside, your only way out will be surviving the countless challenges the tower conceals.

Norse themed Roguelike enemy hell, where you’ll have to survive hordes of creatures that come your way. Unlock new weapons and abilities as you battle. Upgrade your character’s stats with Constellation Ability Trees and slay your enemies before they surround you, or it may be too late…
